What is the y-coordinate of the solution to the system of equations shown?
problem.stimulus:
The solution to the system of equations shown is (x, y).

y = 4x - 4
y = 5x - 7
problem.question: What is the y-coordinate of the solution to the system of equations shown?
problem.explanation: 두 식의 우변이 같으므로 4x - 4 = 5x - 7이다. 양변에서 정리하면 (-1)x = -3이므로 x = -3 ÷ (-1) = 3이다. 이를 y = 4x - 4에 대입하면 y = 4 × 3 - 4 = 8이다. 따라서 y좌표는 8이다.
problem.explanationEn: Since the right-hand sides are equal, 4x - 4 = 5x - 7. Rearranging gives (-1)x = -3, so x = -3 ÷ (-1) = 3. Substituting into y = 4x - 4 gives y = 4 × 3 - 4 = 8. So the y-coordinate is 8.
